response.rationale: R2 matches the histologic eosinophilic infiltrate without systemic eosinophilia or granulomas, fitting idiopathic eosinophilic mastitis. R1 lacks systemic allergic features beyond rhinitis, and R3 is explicitly excluded.

rejected.why: Only seasonal rhinitis, no acute allergic symptoms or systemic eosinophilia to explain breast lesion.
